name: Isometric Weave
description: A tilted isometric lattice of dashed and dotted outlines in a mixed ink palette, built from one repeating tile viewed at an angle.

code.style: --rule: ( --wStyle: @p(dashed, solid, dotted); --wColor: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); grid-row-end: span @p(2, 4); grid-column-end: span @lp(); margin: -1px; border: 2px @var(--wStyle) @var(--wColor); outline: 2px @var(--wStyle) @var(--wColor); outline-offset: -8px; background: linear-gradient(@r(360deg), @var(--wColor), @var(--wColor)) 50% 50% / calc(8% + 1px) calc(8% + 1px) no-repeat; :after, :before { content: ''; position: absolute; margin: auto; outline: 2px @var(--wStyle) @var(--wColor); outline-offset: 2px; @size: @pn(25%, 50%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: 200x1 / ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; box-sizing:border-box; background: var(--color0); } :container { transform: rotateX(45deg) rotate(45deg) scale(2); grid-template-rows: auto; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, calc(.5em + 1vmin)); grid-auto-rows: calc(.5em + 1vmin); grid-auto-flow: dense; overflow:hidden; }
